scope: own-turn discards in the mawashi state (pf_hmm Viterbi M, weighted by the M posterior), own not in riichi, any shanten, riichi or not; scored against every other seat and combined per type (combine)
optimizer: schedulefree.RAdamScheduleFree lr 0.01 wd 0.0001 (tau: no decay), mini-batch 1024 decisions, epochs (curve 'update' = epoch)
